name: worker-agent-cloud
description: Worker Agent.Cloud — Mission Control for AI-powered content networks. Research trends, create content, enforce governance, run channels, and learn from every result. Includes MCP client for connecting external Model Context Protocol servers.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck

scripts.local:infra: docker compose up -d mysql redis minio
